FM12.reasoning: The agent combines the predictions of LightGBM and CatBoost using a simple equal-weight average without attempting to tune the blend weights.

other_failure_modes.name: No validation metric computed
other_failure_modes.description: The agent performs cross-validation but never computes or reports a performance metric on the validation folds (or out-of-fold predictions), making it impossible to evaluate model generalisation before submission.

other_failure_modes.name: Missing early stopping for LightGBM
other_failure_modes.description: The agent creates a validation split inside the cross-validation loop but fails to pass it to the LightGBM model for early stopping, training for a fixed 1000 iterations which risks overfitting.

summary: The agent implements a solid cross-validation pipeline with LightGBM and CatBoost but fails to calculate any validation metrics to assess model performance. Additionally, it uses a naive equal-weight ensemble and neglects to use the validation fold for LightGBM early stopping, which could lead to suboptimal ensembling and overfitting.
